$comment: Prompt manifest for the hand-generated art (spec section 8). Each asset's prompt is self-contained so a single file can be regenerated later without reconstructing context. Generated by hand in the ChatGPT app; nothing here is called at runtime.

generation.backgroundException: icon.png is generated on a solid background; see its note.
generation.postProcess: Downscale every file except icon.png to 512x512, then run through an optimiser (oxipng or ImageOptim). These ship to phones over someone's flat wifi.

workflow: 1. Generate chip-01 first and keep regenerating until the style is right. It is the anchor for the whole set.

2. For chip-02 onward, attach chip-01 as a reference image and append this line to the prompt: 'Keep the same chip proportions, softly modelled 3D felt-and-clay finish, rounded forms, dimensional edging and face style as the reference. Change only the body colour and the accessory. Do not redesign the character.'
3. Do the same for winner, broke and empty, which are the same character in different moods.
4. rebuy-burst, pot-stack and icon have no face. Use a finished chip character as a style reference for pot-stack; rebuy-burst and icon need no reference.
5. Save each file under public/art/ using the exact filename in this manifest. The filenames are load-bearing: avatar_key maps straight onto them.
sharedStyle: Polished soft 3D character illustration with tactile felt-and-clay materials, gently rounded forms, subtle two-tone modelling and ambient occlusion, dark dimensional edging, and a limited palette of deep green felt, warm cream, warm red and antique gold. Every player avatar differs by chip colour plus exactly one accessory, so the set reads as a family.
